description:
Binder design tool selection and workflow routing guidance. Use this skill when: (1) Deciding between BoltzGen, BindCraft, or RFdiffusion, (2) Planning a binder design campaign, (3) Understanding trade-offs between different approaches, (4) Selecting tools for specific target types.
For specific tool parameters, use the individual tool skills (boltzgen, bindcraft, rfdiffusion, etc.).
